m/gravity/2026/swift-21-ltd.description: Precision welded, specially shaped lightweight and strong aluminum. Gravity's own special FBSeries tube-set. Well engineered top tube and downtube, designed for responsive performance while maintaining a comfortable ride quality. Semi-compact geometry allows for a more comfortable and upright position and easy straddling. Yet is still aero-enough for some serious riding if you tuck down from the flat bars. Plush Saddle, Powerful V brakes and rear rack mounts make this the perfect Commuter, Lifestyle bike. Compare to bikes from Trek, Specialized or Giant Flat bar bikes with V Brakes selling for around $600+. Ideal combination of capability, durability, speed and comfort at a fantastic price
